events.title: Olafur Eliasson: Presence
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Bank
events.description: An immersive, multi-sensory exhibition by Icelandic-Danish artist Olafur Eliasson, celebrating his three-decade career with major works like Riverbed and a visitor-built Lego city. Runs until July 12.

events.title: GOMA Friday Night — Olafur Eliasson: Presence (Up Late)
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Bank
events.description: Experience GOMA after dark with art, music, performances, and cocktails, set against Olafur Eliasson's immersive exhibition. A social and cultural destination for Friday evenings.

events.title: Archie Moore — kith and kin
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Bank
events.description: Archie Moore's extensive drawing, showcased at the Venice Biennale, traces 65,000+ years of Kamilaroi and Bigambul relations, emphasising kinship between humans, animals, plants, and land.

events.title: Eat Slay Zombie
events.datetime: 18–24 May, check La Boite for times
events.description: A unique theatre production by Alinta McGrady and Lisa Fa'alafi, transforming a zombie apocalypse into a story of Blak women's friendship, resistance, and found family in a bowling alley.

events.title: The Waterboys — Live
events.description: Celebrated Celtic rock/folk legends The Waterboys perform live, known for their atmospheric and literary songwriting. A great concert for thoughtful music lovers.

events.title: Aries — tsubi club
events.description: Aries plays an intimate gig at The Triffid, one of Brisbane's best-loved live music venues with a loyal community.

events.title: Of Monsters and Men — The Mouse Parade Tour
events.description: Iceland's indie-folk favourites Of Monsters and Men return after six years with their new album and 'The Mouse Parade Tour', delivering soaring harmonies and captivating melodies.

events.title: KT Tunstall — Live
events.datetime: Fri 22 May, Evening (check Princess Theatre site)
events.description: Acclaimed Scottish singer-songwriter KT Tunstall performs live, known for her intimate and emotionally resonant performances.

events.title: aleksiah
events.description: Discover emerging Brisbane indie-pop artist aleksiah at The Triffid, offering a chance to catch new local talent in a beloved intimate venue.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival — Final Week
events.location: Various (Brisbane Powerhouse, The Tivoli, The Princess Theatre, Fortitude Music Hall)
events.description: The final week of Brisbane's biggest comedy event, featuring over 130 artists from megastars to up-and-comers across multiple venues. Look for specific shows like Luke Heggie or late-night variety.

events.title: Chaos (Brisbane Comedy Festival)
events.description: Part of the Brisbane Comedy Festival, 'Chaos' is a specific performance running at Brisbane Powerhouse, promising laughter and unpredictable acts from May 14 through June 7.

events.title: Anywhere Festival Brisbane — Week 4
events.description: Week 4 of Brisbane's festival of site-specific performances, where theatre, circus, music, and storytelling pop up in unexpected places like backyards, ferries, and warehouses.

events.title: Anywhere Festival: The Paint Factory Hub
events.description: An extraordinary festival hub within the Anywhere Festival, taking over the former Taubman's Paint Factory site to host 35 performances in warehouses and unusual spaces over four days.

events.title: Paniyiri Greek Festival — 50th Anniversary
events.location: Musgrave Park & The Greek Club, West End / South Brisbane
events.description: Brisbane's annual Paniyiri Greek Festival celebrates 50 years with its biggest event yet, offering two days of Greek food, entertainment, and cultural celebration for over 50,000 visitors.

events.title: Brisbane Sustainability Festival
events.description: Learn from eco-experts, enjoy live entertainment, explore artisan markets, meet wildlife, and participate in hands-on activities at this free festival celebrating sustainability.

events.title: UQ Poche Centre — National Reconciliation Week Seminar Series
events.datetime: Check UQ website for specific sessions 18–24 May
events.description: The UQ Poche Centre hosts a seminar series as part of National Reconciliation Week, featuring discussions and presentations on Indigenous culture, history, and reconciliation.

events.title: SLQ Curator's Tour: Extraordinary Stories & Treasures
events.datetime: Check SLQ website for May 2026 session times
events.location: State Library of Queensland, South Bank
events.description: Join a guided tour of State Library's heritage collections on Level 4, exploring the Extraordinary Stories exhibition featuring unique tales of ordinary Queenslanders.

events.title: SLQ Conversation: What Is Your Digital Afterlife?
events.datetime: Check SLQ website for May session times
events.location: State Library of Queensland, South Bank
events.description: Part of the Dearly Departed: death in life program, this conversation explores the concept of digital legacy and what happens to our online presence after we're gone.

events.title: SLQ Exhibition Tour: Through Mununjali Eyes
events.datetime: Check SLQ website for tour dates in May
events.location: State Library of Queensland, South Bank
events.description: A guided tour of the Through Mununjali eyes exhibition, celebrating the work of trailblazing photojournalist Wayne Coolwell and his contributions to Indigenous storytelling.
